## 4a8659653d07

**Reproduced defect — count/palette controls are ignored and the advertised size domain is partly impossible.** At generator SHA-256 `dfeec1b008d5960c466f9f1535154dd321e5a4efc19f12ccfb4a2a864afc5ee0`, seed `123`, sample index `5`, requests `{n_active_cols: 2, palette_size: 1}` and `{n_active_cols: 10, palette_size: 9}` return byte-identical 6×9 inputs. The returned input has six active columns and four non-background colors, so neither exact request is honored. The implementation chooses both quantities from `layout` RNG rather than their declared axes. It also rejects advertised-valid `grid_h=12, grid_w=12` with `ValueError: draw_int('grid_h'): override 12 outside [5, 8]`. Reproducer and exact returned grid: `checks/audit/4a8659653d07/reproduce_ignored_axes.py` and `checks/audit/4a8659653d07/repro.json`. I checked the current generator, summary/notes, all five canonical input/output dimensions, deterministic equality, active-column recovery, and returned color support; the pack-nonempty-columns rule itself was not challenged by this contract-level defect.
